<!doctype html>
<html lang="de">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover" />
  <title>Dzud – Winter 2023/24 · v9.4.2 GitHub Pages</title>
  <style>
    :root{
      --bg: rgb(239,236,228);
      --panel: rgba(248,246,240,.94);
      --text: rgb(69,68,64);
      --muted: rgb(118,114,106);
      --line: rgb(132,127,118);
      --accent: rgb(214,112,58);
      --accent-soft: rgba(214,112,58,.18);
      --timeline-left: 8.59375%;
      --timeline-width: 82.8125%;
      --timeline-y: 92.963%;
    }

    *{box-sizing:border-box}
    html,body{
      margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;
      background:var(--bg);
      font-family:"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
      color:var(--text);
      user-select:none;
      touch-action:none;
    }
    body{display:grid;place-items:center}

    #stage{
      position:relative;
      width:min(100vw,calc(100vh * 16 / 9));
      height:min(100vh,calc(100vw * 9 / 16));
      background:var(--bg);
      overflow:hidden;
    }

    #video{
      position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;
      object-fit:contain;background:var(--bg);
      pointer-events:none;z-index:1;
    }

    /* SVG liegt pixelgenau über dem 1920×1080-Video. */
    #mapOverlay{
      position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;
      z-index:5;
      overflow:visible;
    }

    .aimag{
      fill:rgba(239,236,228,.025);
      stroke:rgba(82,80,75,.48);
      stroke-width:1.55;
      vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:fill .12s ease, stroke .12s ease, stroke-width .12s ease;
      pointer-events:all;
    }
    .aimag:hover{
      fill:rgba(214,112,58,.12);
      stroke:rgba(69,68,64,.78);
      stroke-width:2;
    }
    .aimag.selected{
      fill:var(--accent-soft);
      stroke:var(--accent);
      stroke-width:3;
    }

    .context-label{
      fill:var(--text);
      font-size:25px;
      letter-spacing:8px;
      opacity:.38;
      pointer-events:none;
    }
    .city-dot{
      fill:var(--accent);
      stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.92);
      stroke-width:3;
      pointer-events:none;
    }
    .city-label{
      fill:var(--text);
      font-size:27px;
      font-weight:600;
      paint-order:stroke;
      stroke:rgba(239,236,228,.9);
      stroke-width:8px;
      stroke-linejoin:round;
      pointer-events:none;
    }

    #infoPanel{
      position:absolute;
      right:2.2%;
      top:5%;
      width:23%;
      min-width:320px;
      max-height:82%;
      overflow:hidden;
      z-index:8;
      background:var(--panel);
      border:1px solid rgba(110,105,96,.22);
      border-radius:16px;
      box-shadow:0 10px 34px rgba(55,50,42,.08);
      padding:22px 22px 18px;
      backdrop-filter:blur(9px);
      pointer-events:none;
    }

    #infoPanel.empty .data-content{display:none}
    #infoPanel:not(.empty) .empty-content{display:none}

    .eyebrow{
      font-size:12px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      letter-spacing:.15em;
      color:var(--muted);
      margin-bottom:7px;
    }

    h1{
      font-size:25px;
      line-height:1.08;
      margin:0 0 4px;
      font-weight:650;
    }

    .mongolian{
      font-size:13px;
      color:var(--muted);
      margin-bottom:18px;
    }

    .empty-content{
      font-size:15px;
      line-height:1.45;
      color:var(--muted);
    }

    .metric{
      border-top:1px solid rgba(110,105,96,.20);
      padding-top:13px;
      margin-top:11px;
    }
    .metric-head{
      display:flex;
      align-items:baseline;
      justify-content:space-between;
      gap:12px;
      margin-bottom:8px;
    }
    .metric-title{
      font-size:13px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      letter-spacing:.07em;
      color:var(--muted);
    }
    .metric-value{
      font-size:26px;
      line-height:1;
      font-weight:650;
      white-space:nowrap;
    }
    .metric-sub{
      font-size:12px;
      color:var(--muted);
      margin-top:5px;
    }

    .species{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:62px 1fr 58px;
      align-items:center;
      gap:7px;
      margin:6px 0;
      font-size:12px;
    }
    .species-name{color:var(--text)}
    .bar{
      height:6px;border-radius:999px;
      background:rgba(95,91,84,.12);
      overflow:hidden;
    }
    .bar > span{
      display:block;height:100%;
      width:0%;
      background:rgba(92,108,117,.68);
      border-radius:999px;
    }
    .loss-bars .bar > span{background:rgba(214,112,58,.72)}
    .species-value{text-align:right;color:var(--muted)}

    .warning{
      margin-top:12px;
      font-size:10.5px;
      line-height:1.35;
      color:var(--muted);
    }


    /* Klima-Panel: wird direkt aus ERA5_daily_partial.json gespeist. */
    #climatePanel{
      position:absolute;
      left:2.2%;
      top:5%;
      width:18.5%;
      min-width:265px;
      z-index:8;
      background:rgba(248,246,240,.93);
      border:1px solid rgba(110,105,96,.20);
      border-radius:16px;
      box-shadow:0 10px 34px rgba(55,50,42,.07);
      padding:18px 19px 16px;
      backdrop-filter:blur(9px);
      pointer-events:none;
    }

    #climatePanel .climate-date{
      font-size:13px;
      color:var(--muted);
      margin-bottom:10px;
    }

    .climate-main{
      display:flex;
      align-items:flex-end;
      gap:8px;
      margin-bottom:10px;
    }

    .climate-temp{
      font-size:42px;
      line-height:.95;
      font-weight:650;
      letter-spacing:-.03em;
    }

    .climate-unit{
      font-size:15px;
      color:var(--muted);
      margin-bottom:5px;
    }

    .climate-grid{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
      gap:8px 12px;
      padding-top:10px;
      border-top:1px solid rgba(110,105,96,.18);
    }

    .climate-item .label{
      font-size:10px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      letter-spacing:.08em;
      color:var(--muted);
    }

    .climate-item .value{
      margin-top:2px;
      font-size:17px;
      font-weight:600;
    }

    #climateAvailability{
      margin-top:11px;
      font-size:10.5px;
      line-height:1.3;
      color:var(--muted);
    }

    #climatePanel.missing .climate-temp,
    #climatePanel.missing .climate-grid{
      opacity:.32;
    }



    /* v8: annual migration as long-term context, not a daily Dzud variable */
    .migration-metric .metric-value.positive{color:rgb(87,112,96)}
    .migration-metric .metric-value.negative{color:rgb(177,91,59)}
    .migration-row{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
      gap:8px 12px;
      margin:8px 0 7px;
    }
    .migration-kpi .kpi-label{
      font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--muted);
    }
    .migration-kpi .kpi-value{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;margin-top:2px}
    #migrationSparkline{display:block;width:100%;height:62px;margin:6px 0 2px;overflow:visible}
    .mig-zero{stroke:rgba(100,96,88,.25);stroke-width:1;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
    .mig-line{fill:none;stroke:rgba(89,104,112,.82);stroke-width:2;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
    .mig-point{fill:var(--accent);stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.9);stroke-width:1.5;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
    .mig-year-label{font-size:8px;fill:var(--muted)}

    /* Optional v8 environment image. Kept deliberately atmospheric and separate
       from the quantitative map so it is not mistaken for dated evidence. */
    #environmentCard{
      position:absolute;
      left:22.2%; top:5%; width:17.5%; height:15.5%;
      z-index:6; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden;
      border:1px solid rgba(110,105,96,.18);
      box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(55,50,42,.07);
      pointer-events:none;
      background:rgba(248,246,240,.45);
      display:none;
    }
    #environmentCard.has-image{display:block}
    #environmentCard img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;filter:saturate(.78) contrast(.95)}
    #environmentCard::after{
      content:"Atmosphäre · Kontextbild";
      position:absolute;left:10px;bottom:8px;
      padding:4px 7px;border-radius:999px;
      background:rgba(248,246,240,.82);color:var(--muted);
      font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.04em;
    }
    #scrubber{
      position:absolute;
      left:var(--timeline-left);
      width:var(--timeline-width);
      top:var(--timeline-y);
      height:10%;
      transform:translateY(-50%);
      margin:0;padding:0;
      opacity:.001;
      cursor:ew-resize;
      touch-action:none;
      z-index:12;
    }

    #hint{
      position:absolute;
      left:50%;bottom:8%;
      transform:translateX(-50%);
      padding:.5em .9em;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:rgba(248,246,240,.94);
      color:var(--text);
      font-size:clamp(12px,1.1vw,21px);
      pointer-events:none;
      opacity:0;
      transition:opacity .35s ease;
      white-space:nowrap;
      z-index:11;
    }
    #hint.show{opacity:1}

    #status{
      position:absolute;
      left:2%;top:2%;
      z-index:20;
      opacity:0;
      background:rgba(248,246,240,.9);
      border-radius:6px;
      padding:.35em .55em;
      color:var(--muted);
      font-size:12px;
      pointer-events:none;
    }

    #stage.debug #status{opacity:1}
    #stage.debug #scrubber{
      opacity:.25;
      background:rgba(214,112,58,.2);
      outline:2px solid rgba(214,112,58,.8);
    }

    #errorBox{
      display:none;
      position:absolute;left:4%;right:4%;bottom:4%;
      z-index:30;
      color:white;background:rgba(115,40,25,.94);
      padding:14px 18px;border-radius:9px;
      font-size:14px;line-height:1.4;
    }
    #errorBox.show{display:block}
  
    /* v9.2 core integration */
    #coreDailyAvailability{
      margin-top:5px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.25;color:var(--muted);
    }
    #contextPanel{
      position:absolute;left:2.2%;top:45%;width:18.5%;min-width:265px;
      z-index:8;background:rgba(248,246,240,.93);
      border:1px solid rgba(110,105,96,.20);border-radius:16px;
      box-shadow:0 10px 34px rgba(55,50,42,.07);
      padding:16px 19px 14px;backdrop-filter:blur(9px);pointer-events:none;
    }
    #contextPanel h2{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:20px;line-height:1.08;font-weight:650}
    .core-today{
      margin:9px 0 10px;padding:8px 0 9px;
      border-top:1px solid rgba(110,105,96,.16);
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(110,105,96,.16);
      font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;color:var(--muted);
    }
    .core-today strong{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
    .context-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px 12px}
    .context-item .label{
      font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.075em;color:var(--muted)
    }
    .context-item .value{margin-top:2px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.15;font-weight:600}
    .context-item.wide{grid-column:1 / -1}
    .context-item.wide .value{font-size:12px;line-height:1.25;font-weight:550}
    #contextSource{margin-top:9px;font-size:9.5px;line-height:1.25;color:var(--muted)}
    
  
    /* v9.3 thematic layer station */
    #layerNav{
      position:absolute;left:22.3%;right:25.2%;top:2.6%;z-index:18;
      display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      pointer-events:auto;
    }
    .layer-btn{
      appearance:none;border:1px solid rgba(100,96,88,.22);
      background:rgba(248,246,240,.9);color:var(--muted);
      border-radius:999px;padding:7px 10px 6px;
      font:600 9.5px/1 "Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
      letter-spacing:.055em;text-transform:uppercase;
      cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;white-space:nowrap;
      box-shadow:0 3px 13px rgba(55,50,42,.035);
    }
    .layer-btn.active{
      color:var(--text);background:rgba(248,246,240,.99);
      border-color:rgba(214,112,58,.66);
      box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(214,112,58,.13);
    }
    .layer-btn:disabled{opacity:.36;cursor:default;border-style:dashed}
    #layerInfo{
      position:absolute;left:29%;right:31%;top:8.3%;z-index:7;
      min-height:59px;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:12px;
      border:1px solid rgba(110,105,96,.16);
      background:rgba(248,246,240,.84);
      box-shadow:0 6px 22px rgba(55,50,42,.04);
      backdrop-filter:blur(7px);pointer-events:none;text-align:center;
    }
    .layer-kicker{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.11em;color:var(--muted)}
    .layer-title{margin-top:2px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.15;font-weight:620;color:var(--text)}
    .layer-sub{margin-top:3px;font-size:9.5px;line-height:1.25;color:var(--muted)}
    .layer-metric{margin-top:3px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.25;color:rgb(107,100,90)}
    #timelineCover{
      display:none;position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:16.8%;
      z-index:10;background:rgba(239,236,228,.98);pointer-events:none;
      align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--muted);
      font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.04em;
    }
    #timelineModeLabel{
      display:none;position:absolute;left:8.3%;bottom:8.2%;z-index:11;
      background:rgb(239,236,228);padding:2px 90px 4px 0;
      font-size:18px;color:var(--text);pointer-events:none;
    }
    #stage.theme-static #timelineCover{display:flex}
    #stage.theme-static #scrubber{pointer-events:none}
    #stage.theme-wind #timelineModeLabel{display:block}

    .theme-basin{
      fill:rgba(112,151,164,.035);stroke:rgba(88,126,140,.42);
      stroke-width:1.1;stroke-dasharray:4 4;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;
    }
    .theme-basin.endo{
      fill:rgba(101,147,163,.13);stroke:rgba(70,113,131,.62);stroke-width:1.4;
    }
    .theme-river{
      fill:none;stroke:rgba(82,139,163,.78);stroke-width:1.15;
      vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;stroke-linecap:round;
    }
    .theme-lake{
      fill:rgba(86,143,169,.62);stroke:rgba(70,121,144,.8);
      stroke-width:.8;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;
    }
    .theme-eco{
      stroke:rgba(248,246,240,.72);stroke-width:1.4;
      vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;opacity:.76;
    }
    .wind-arrow-line{
      stroke:rgba(75,103,113,.84);stroke-width:2.2;
      vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;stroke-linecap:round;
    }
    .wind-arrow-head{fill:rgba(75,103,113,.88)}
    .wind-arrow-dot{
      fill:rgba(248,246,240,.9);stroke:rgba(75,103,113,.72);
      stroke-width:1.2;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;
    }
    .wind-arrow.selected .wind-arrow-line{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:3.1}
    .wind-arrow.selected .wind-arrow-head{fill:var(--accent)}
    .wind-arrow.selected .wind-arrow-dot{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2}
    
  
    /* v9.3.1 language switch + rebuilt language-aware timeline */
    #languageSwitch{
      position:absolute;right:2.2%;top:1.25%;z-index:24;
      display:flex;gap:3px;padding:3px;border-radius:999px;
      background:rgba(248,246,240,.94);
      border:1px solid rgba(110,105,96,.20);
      box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(55,50,42,.05);
      pointer-events:auto;
    }
    .lang-btn{
      appearance:none;min-width:38px;height:28px;border:0;border-radius:999px;
      background:transparent;color:var(--muted);
      font:650 10px/1 "Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
      letter-spacing:.04em;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;
    }
    .lang-btn.active{
      color:var(--text);background:rgba(214,112,58,.15);
      box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(214,112,58,.42);
    }

    #i18nTimeline{
      position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:17.2%;
      z-index:9;background:var(--bg);pointer-events:none;
    }
    #i18nTimelineTitle{
      position:absolute;left:8.59375%;top:15%;
      font-size:18px;line-height:1.15;font-weight:500;
      color:var(--text);white-space:nowrap;
    }
    #i18nTimelineLine{
      position:absolute;left:8.59375%;width:82.8125%;top:55%;
      border-top:2px solid rgba(103,99,91,.72);
    }
    #i18nTimelineDate{
      position:absolute;top:23%;transform:translateX(-50%);
      padding:4px 10px 3px;border-radius:7px;
      background:rgba(248,246,240,.96);color:var(--text);
      font-size:27px;line-height:1;font-weight:650;white-space:nowrap;
    }
    #i18nTimelineDot{
      position:absolute;top:calc(55% - 8px);
      width:17px;height:17px;transform:translateX(-50%);
      border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);
    }
    #i18nTimelineTicks{
      position:absolute;left:8.59375%;width:82.8125%;
      top:55%;height:38%;
    }
    .i18n-month{
      position:absolute;top:0;transform:translateX(-50%);
      color:var(--text);font-size:16px;line-height:1;
      text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;
    }
    .i18n-month::before{
      content:"";display:block;width:1px;height:12px;
      margin:0 auto 9px;background:rgba(103,99,91,.72);
    }
    .i18n-month.first{transform:none;text-align:left}
    .i18n-month.first::before{margin-left:0}
    #stage.theme-static #i18nTimeline{display:none}
    
  
    /* ==========================================================
       v9.4 PREVIEW — animated wind particles
       Uses the existing 22 daily Aimag vectors as anchor points
       and interpolates a continuous visual field in-browser.
       This is a visual preview, not yet the full native ERA5 grid.
       ========================================================== */
    #windParticleCanvas{
      position:absolute;
      inset:0;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      z-index:4;
      pointer-events:none;
      display:none;
    }
    #stage.theme-wind #windParticleCanvas{display:block}
    #windParticleBadge{
      display:none;
      position:absolute;
      left:50%;
      top:14.8%;
      transform:translateX(-50%);
      z-index:7;
      padding:5px 9px 4px;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:rgba(248,246,240,.88);
      border:1px solid rgba(100,96,88,.15);
      color:var(--muted);
      font-size:9px;
      letter-spacing:.055em;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      pointer-events:none;
      white-space:nowrap;
    }
    #stage.theme-wind #windParticleBadge{display:block}

  </style>
  <meta name="dzud-build" content="v7-offline-embedded-data">
  <meta name="dzud-build" content="v8.1-migration-environment-fixed">
  <meta name="dzud-build" content="v9.2.1-core-offline">
  <meta name="dzud-build" content="v9.3.1-thematic-layers-i18n">
  <meta name="dzud-build" content="v9.4-wind-particles-preview">
  <meta name="dzud-build" content="v9.4.1-wind-particles-optimized">
  <meta name="dzud-build" content="v9.4.2-wind-particles-continuous">
  <meta name="dzud-build" content="v9.4.2-ipad-singlefile">
  <meta name="dzud-build" content="v9.4.2-github-pages">
</head>

<body>
<main id="stage">

  <video id="video" muted playsinline webkit-playsinline preload="auto"></video>


  <canvas id="windParticleCanvas" width="1920" height="1080" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
  <div id="windParticleBadge">Kontinuierliches Strömungsfeld · ohne Tages-Sprünge · aus 22 Aimag-Tagesvektoren interpoliert</div>

  <svg id="mapOverlay"
       viewBox="0 0 1920 1080"
       preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
       aria-label="Aimag-Grenzen der Mongolei">

    <g id="context">
      <text class="context-label" x="1375" y="125" text-anchor="middle">RUSSLAND</text>
      <text class="context-label" x="1455" y="835" text-anchor="middle">CHINA</text>
    </g>


    <g id="thematicLayers" pointer-events="none">
      <rect id="mapVeil" x="0" y="146" width="1920" height="638"
            fill="rgb(239,236,228)" opacity="0" style="display:none"></rect>

      <image id="themeRelief" x="0" y="146" width="1920" height="638"
             preserveAspectRatio="none" href="data:image/png;base64," style="display:none"></image>
      <image id="themeMoisture" x="0" y="146" width="1920" height="638"
             preserveAspectRatio="none" href="data:image/png;base64," style="display:none"></image>
      <image id="themeTempRange" x="0" y="146" width="1920" height="638"
             preserveAspectRatio="none" href="data:image/png;base64,
